question: Can an unchanged 489-parameter continuous-history GRU discover a competent real CartPole policy from only its own executed actions and observed rewards using PPO, compared to a similarly parameterized MLP, equal-budget reward-credit corruption, random/untrained actors and a fully competent supervised conventional P19 control?
null: Across any of 3 initialization seeds, the reward-only GRU does not attain >=150/200 on new public DEV CartPole seeds, fails to exceed same-source random/untrained controls by >=75 or the same-budget reward-credit-corrupted GRU by >=40, or fails to retain >=100/200 on short and long source-instance pole length perturbations. Such failures are retained, never retuned on exposed eval seeds.

design.actors: Unchanged original P18 489-param HistoryGRU and 471-param FullHistoryMLP (no tokens or transformer) both 8 factual rows, four real sensed state variables + previous actually executed action + already observed reward.
design.positive_gradient_signal: Clipped PPO Categorical policy gradient from each actor's OWN executed action, real reward-to-go GAE, learned true value baseline, no teacher action labels, no engine hidden state.
design.credit_negative: Same GRU architecture / old initialization and PPO batch/epochs/horizon, but actor advantage is rotated 32 time steps and one environment. Critic value targets remain factual; source reward samples remain genuine; invalid causal attribution is deliberate.
design.train_reset_seed_rule: Initial reset of env slot j: 82000+1000*j; on completed episode k reset 82000+1000*j+k; same deterministic source rule and actions budget, naturally different trajectories per learned policy, no science seeds.
design.source_dynamics: Real pinned Gymnasium CartPole-v1 source instances; short pole length ratio 0.7 and long 1.3. Also set source-instance polemass_length derived from same public engine parameter. Actual physics changed before reset; models cannot access ratio or engine parameters. This is a developer-authored variation of one known environment, NOT independently novel science.
design.P19_supervised_comparator: Original P19 source trains observation-only linear 700 and history GRU 900 AdamW on original 48 factual supervised teacher episodes, each comparator seed [2819,2833,2843]. It is strictly a frozen evaluation reference, never an action label for any PPO learner.
